messages:
sam: Heads-up — scheduling a dry-run rollout of per-route concurrency caps in west-1 next Tue 02:00 UTC. Goal is to tame noisy-tenant p99 tails. Dry-run mode = metrics + audit logs only, no requests dropped unless someone flips 'enforce'. After the dry-run we’ll run a 20m light stress test to validate behavior. Plan summary below.

sam: ```
- Window: Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC (canary + dry-run)
- Targets: dedicated-gpu pools first (ded-west-1-a), then small-batch hosted routes
- Dry-run: caps reported and enforced in monitor mode (no REJECT)
- Stress test: 02:30-02:50 UTC light synthetic traffic to exercise circuit breakers
- Rollback: automatic disable if error rate > 1% or p99 increase > 20%
```

maria: Quick q — any SLA/SLO changes planned or do we expect customer-visible errors?

sam: No SLA change planned. Dry-run will not drop traffic. We will run SLO sims after the stress test and surface any recommended SLO recalibration to product. If we see regressions, we roll back the monitor toggles and pause the rollout.

lee: Can we canary this on dedicated pools only first? I want to avoid hitting shared hosted routes.

sam: Yes — canary will be dedicated-only for the first two cycles (ded-west-1-a). Hosted routes get monitor flags after canary looks good.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Scheduled maintenance: per-route concurrency dry-run in eng-sre for west-1 on Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. No traffic drops expected. See #sre-alerts for live updates.

jonathan: Heads-up — KV-cache warmup might interact with caps if many cold prefixes show up during the stress test. Are we pre-warming common prefixes?

sam: Good point. We'll pre-warm top-1000 prefixes for the synthetic traffic and extend KV TTLs by +30s during the window. Also monitoring for cache fill-rate and prefix-evictions.

ethan: Who's the escalation contact during the window? Pager?

sam: Primary oncall is eng-oncall (pager). I (sam) will be secondary. For infra-level rollbacks reach out to lee and ops. Ops runbook: https://wiki.internal/sre/per-route-caps-rollout (dry-run section).

ops-bot: Confirmed: canary group = ded-west-1-a, synthetic test job scheduled job-id=22034, quiet-hours flag set. I will post start/end messages to this thread.

maria: Thanks — sounds reasonable. Please post the final signal thresholds you’ll watch.

sam: Will do, posting thresholds to #sre-alerts and the runbook before EOD today. :thumbsup:
